basics.name: Crishna Korukanti
basics.label: Full Stack Engineer & AI Product Developer
basics.summary: I took a hands-on path to engineering—mastering Android development at a bootcamp, then going from student to teacher, and leading mobile engineering for apps with 10M+ downloads. Today, I build resilient full-stack AI platforms, lead engineering teams, and help aspiring developers find their vibe.

work.name: HelloVibe
work.summary: Founded as a side hustle to help aspiring developers master 'vibe coding'—the art of intuitive, product-minded development.
highlights: Building a community-driven platform for developer education.
Creating content and tools to bridge the gap between coding and product thinking.

work.name: Aiphant Technologies
work.summary: Leading engineering initiatives for global clients, specializing in AI adaptation and full-stack product development.
highlights: LetMeDoIt: Took total engineering lead, building Android & iOS apps, backend systems, and CI/CD pipelines. Led the team to achieve all launch milestones.
Soleil Space: Partnered with this media platform to build and launch their cross-platform mobile experience using React Native.
Perc: Built an internal AI-based movie and shows suggestion engine for a US Media Giant, pioneering early AI adaptation in their workflow.

work.name: SurveyHeart LLP
work.summary: Promoted to lead mobile strategy after successful Android contributions. Scaled products to over 10M+ downloads.
highlights: Launched and scaled the iOS application from scratch.
Led the migration of the legacy Android codebase from Java to Kotlin, significantly improving performance and maintainability.
Managed the mobile engineering team to support rapid user growth.

work.name: SurveyHeart LLP
work.summary: Joined as a core Android developer and quickly took ownership of key features.
highlights: Played a key role in scaling the Android app to millions of users.
Optimized app performance and contributed to the early stages of the Java-to-Kotlin migration.

work.name: Masai School
work.summary: Recruited directly after graduation to teach the next generation of developers.
highlights: Taught Java, Kotlin, and Android Development to student cohorts.
mentored students through technical challenges and interview preparation.
Contributed to the development of internal tools and projects for the school.

projects.name: LetMeDoIt
projects.description: Engineering Lead. Built comprehensive backend systems, CI/CD pipelines, and launched native mobile apps for iOS and Android.
projects.caseStudy: Faced the challenge of managing a complex ecosystem of mobile apps and backend services while ensuring rapid deployment cycles. Built an AI agent to help users with disabilities make decisions, enabling seamless decision-making support across the platform.

projects.name: Soleil Space
projects.description: Built and launched cross-platform mobile apps (Android & iOS) using React Native for media streaming.
projects.caseStudy: Delivered a consistent, high-quality media streaming experience across Android and iOS by leveraging React Native for cross-platform efficiency, while writing native modules for performance-critical media features.

projects.name: SurveyHeart
projects.description: Mobile survey platform with over 10M+ downloads.
projects.caseStudy: Ensured a consistent, high-quality survey experience across both platforms by leveraging Kotlin and Swift for native efficiency, while writing shared modules for performance-critical survey features that scaled to 10M+ downloads.
